eventGallery.title: Event gallery
eventGallery.lead: Find photos and videos published by the association team after the gathering.
eventGallery.demo: Demonstration: these images are fictitious and stay in this browser. They do not prove a real video upload.
eventGallery.beforeEnd: The gallery will open after the event ends, on {{date}} ({{zone}}).
eventGallery.awaitingServer: Your device shows that the event has ended. The gallery is still waiting for the service to open it.
eventGallery.cancelled: The gallery is closed for this cancelled event.
eventGallery.associationAudience: Gallery for association members currently allowed to view the event.
eventGallery.networkAudience: Gallery for DIASPORALE members currently allowed to view the event.
eventGallery.composeDescription: Add up to four photos or one video for “{{title}}”. The publication keeps the association’s identity and the event audience.
eventGallery.empty: No accessible media in this gallery yet.
eventGallery.removeHint: This addition will no longer be accessible in the gallery. The event and registrations are kept.
eventGallery.removed: The addition was removed from the gallery.

errors.association_event_gallery_not_open: This gallery is not open or is no longer accessible with your current status.
errors.association_event_gallery_media_required: Add at least one photo or video to the gallery.
